zh: Sanket，你把walk-forward的回测结果发到群里吧。
en: Sanket, please send the walk-forward backtest results to the group.

zh: Rong Xian说这个RFQ的数据要先做回填。
en: Rong Xian said this RFQ data needs to be backfilled first.

zh: 石总觉得静态参数的夏普比滚动优化的高。
en: Dr. Shi thinks the Sharpe of the static parameters is higher than the walk-forward optimization.

zh: Zewei，你看一下CFFEX和SHFE的快照数据有没有断。
en: Zewei, check whether the CFFEX and SHFE snapshot data has any gaps.

zh: CME和ICE推送的是逐笔数据，不是快照。
en: CME and ICE push tick-level data, not snapshots.

zh: 这个策略的最大回撤是百分之十二，Calmar比较低。
en: The max drawdown of this strategy is twelve percent, and the Calmar is fairly low.

zh: Betty和Claire负责把volume bar的指标迁移到117上。
en: Betty and Claire are responsible for migrating the volume bar indicator to 117.

zh: 我用Claude Code把pandas的脚本改成tier one的模板了。
en: I used Claude Code to convert the pandas script into the tier one template.

zh: 反向代理用Nginx，放在Docker Compose里面跑。
en: Use Nginx for the reverse proxy and run it in Docker Compose.

zh: Lichi Shi会把需求写成文档，然后发给大家。
en: Lichi Shi will write the requirements as a document and send it to everyone.

zh: 仿真账号上先跑一周，没问题再上线。
en: Run it on the paper-trading account for a week first, and release it if there are no problems.

zh: Xiu Gao，国泰君安那个期货账号绑定的是哪个策略？
en: Xiu Gao, which strategy is the Guotai Junan futures account bound to?

zh: tier two和tier three的链路已经打通了。
en: The link between tier two and tier three is already working.

zh: 分钟级的粒度不够，我们要看成交量的分布。
en: Minute-level granularity is not enough; we need to look at the volume distribution.

zh: 这个震荡策略在趋势行情里亏得很厉害。
en: This range-bound strategy loses a lot in trending markets.

zh: 调参的时候不要只看夏普，也要看回撤。
en: When tuning parameters, don't only look at the Sharpe, also look at the drawdown.

zh: Sanket提的那个问题，Rong Xian已经修好了。
en: The issue Sanket raised has already been fixed by Rong Xian.

zh: CC跑完以后你检查一下它写的Python代码。
en: After Claude Code finishes, check the Python code it wrote.

zh: 我们把RFQ当成全局的cluster层来用。
en: We use RFQ as the global cluster layer.

zh: 这个walk-forward版本的收益只有百分之十七。
en: The return of this walk-forward version is only seventeen percent.

zh: DCE的数据推送频率是每秒两次。
en: DCE pushes data twice per second.

zh: 石总说下周要看到新的指标上线。
en: Dr. Shi said he wants to see the new indicator released next week.

zh: Zewei演示了怎么在monitor里画ADJ close。
en: Zewei demonstrated how to plot ADJ close in the monitor.

zh: 先回测四千根bar，再用滚动优化验证。
en: First backtest four thousand bars, then validate with walk-forward optimization.

zh: Claire，你那边的Docker镜像更新了吗？
en: Claire, has your Docker image been updated?

zh: 服务器一百点八上的推理服务要加个反向代理。
en: The inference service on server 100.8 needs a reverse proxy.

zh: Betty，你把OFI flow和OI delta的图也加上。
en: Betty, add the OFI flow and OI delta charts too.

zh: 这个问题Lichi Shi两周前就提出来了。
en: Lichi Shi raised this issue two weeks ago.

zh: 我们决定继续用静态参数，不切到walk-forward。
en: We decided to keep using static parameters and not switch to walk-forward.

zh: Sanket，你学一下新的monitor怎么用。
en: Sanket, learn how to use the new monitor.

zh: Xiu Gao说SHFE今天有一段数据缺失。
en: Xiu Gao said SHFE had a gap in the data today.

zh: 回填的时候注意不要把逐笔数据弄丢。
en: When backfilling, be careful not to lose the tick-level data.

zh: Rong Xian会把zip文件发给你。
en: Rong Xian will send you the zip file.

zh: CFFEX的快照是间隔驱动的，每半秒一次。
en: CFFEX snapshots are interval-driven, once every half second.

zh: 用pandas算完以后再写进tier one。
en: Compute it with pandas and then write it into tier one.

zh: 这个指标的粒度等于六十，就是分钟级。
en: The granularity of this indicator equals sixty, which is minute-level.

zh: 期货账号YX开头的那个绑的是静态版本。
en: The futures account starting with YX is bound to the static version.

zh: Nginx配好以后，把universal URL发给Sanket。
en: After Nginx is configured, send the universal URL to Sanket.

zh: Zewei，CME的逐笔数据一毫秒能推几千次。
en: Zewei, CME tick data can push thousands of times in one millisecond.

zh: 石总要Calmar和夏普两个指标一起看。
en: Dr. Shi wants to look at both the Calmar and Sharpe metrics together.
